name: Git and code reviews
note: Questions authored by Claude as practice material. Not sourced from your own notes or any official exam. Verify anything you doubt against the docs.

questions.q: Which command replays your feature-branch commits on top of the latest main?
questions.why: Rebase moves your commits onto the new base and keeps history linear; merge adds a merge commit.

questions.q: You hit conflicts during a rebase and fixed the files. What comes next?
questions.why: Stage the resolved files, then continue the rebase.

questions.q: Undo the last commit but keep its changes staged. Which command?
questions.why: --soft moves the branch back and leaves changes staged. --hard would discard them.

questions.q: You need one specific commit from another branch on your branch. Which command?
questions.why: Cherry-pick applies a single commit as a new commit.

questions.q: Why should you avoid rebasing and force-pushing a branch others already pulled?
options: It rewrites history their work is based on
questions.why: Rewritten commits get new hashes, so teammates' copies diverge.

questions.q: What is the difference between git fetch and git pull?
options: fetch downloads changes without merging; pull fetches then merges or rebases
questions.why: git pull = git fetch + merge (or rebase).

questions.q: Which is the safer way to force-push after a rebase?
questions.why: --force-with-lease refuses to overwrite remote commits you have not seen.

questions.q: Which review comment is most useful on a test PR?
options: This test still passes if the API returns 500 because the status is never asserted. Assert 200 and check the body.
I would have written it differently
questions.why: It names the problem, the risk and a concrete fix.

options: Shelves uncommitted changes so you can switch branches cleanly
questions.why: Stash saves working changes aside; git stash pop restores them.

questions.q: Why prefer git revert over git reset on a shared branch?
options: revert adds a new commit that undoes a change, so history is not rewritten
questions.why: Revert is safe for shared history.
